title: Crispy Haddock with Kosher Dill Sauce
description: A crispy, pan-fried haddock dish served with a tangy kosher dill sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 2. Cut the haddock into 4 equal pieces and season with salt and black pepper.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together the beaten eggs and a pinch of salt.
4. In another shallow dish, place the crisp breadcrumbs.
5. Dip each piece of haddock into the eggs, coating completely, then roll in the breadcrumbs to coat.
6. Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. Add the coated haddock to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
8. Transfer the haddock to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
9. Meanwhile, mix together the kosher dill pickles, mayonnaise, and lemon juice to make the sauce.
10. Serve the haddock with the kosher dill sauce spooned over the top.
